newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo central bank keeps discount rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Yugo central bank keeps discount rate unchanged.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) left its key discount rate for December unchanged at 4.5 percent per month, a central bank official said on Monday.
"Nothing has changed in overall monetary and economic developments," an NBY official told Reuters.
This was the seventh consecutive month that the discount rate was kept unchanged at an annual 68.15 percent.

The discount rate was first cut to 4.5 percent in June from 6.31 in May in an attempt to influence commercial lending rates down, but the reduction in lending rates failed to materialise. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
